scope: Typed version-1 read/unread markers connected through validated comment and mention cache identities to a recorded missing task or parked cancelled selection. No new RPC or hosted change.

core.coverage: Read and unread; single/group; cancelled selection; indirect marker-only receipt refusal; related draft comments and queued deletion; independent conversation exclusion; exact encryption/export round trip; foreign account/recipient, wrong generation/project, missing/duplicate/malformed cache, future revision and unsupported intent refusals.

native.coverage: One new connected-marker group recovery through actual Store backup/vault/persist, cold reopen, readable preview and JSON export; existing single missing-task recovery regression. Actual Mac Save delivery bytes verified; native iOS sharing cancellation. Synthetic peer and reserved signed app only.
native.limitations: Cancelled selections and read=false use Core coverage here. Missing context stays queued/refused. No broad hosted, recurring series, physical device, spoken or provider acceptance claimed.
native.testSetup: Two feature/regression cases passed first. A subsequent self-contained export setup attempt failed before exporting because its sandbox cannot create a top-level /tmp folder. The corrected runner-owned temporary directory passed the one-case rerun; summary, complete proof and actual local delivery are retained separately.

format: Existing encrypted archives remain whole snapshots with actual original command/response. Exports without read markers are unchanged. Exports with markers add conversation_context containing only their connected comment/mention cache rows; original outbox envelopes remain exact. No automatic replay/import or editing grant.
remaining: Unsupported or absent conversation context and single cancelled/provisional marker flows
I/O-phase races, broader native recurring/spoken, large workloads and genuine hosted acceptance
User-deferred release/distribution, remote reminders, older-client rollout safeguards and provider/device setup remain deferred
